reports.title: Alpha Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter 2026

lines: For sales volumes, Alpha expects to ship between 13.1 million and 14.1 million metallurgical tons, as well as another 1.2 million to 1.6 million tons of incidental thermal coal, bringing total 2027 shipment expectations to a range of 14.3 million to 15.7 million tons for the year.
Selling, general and administrative (SG&A) costs are expected to be between $53 million and $59 million in 2027, excluding non-recurring expenses and non-cash stock compensation.
Alpha anticipates 2027 net cash interest income of $2 million to $4 million, and depreciation, depletion and amortization of $148 million to $162 million.
The company expects a 2027 cash tax rate of between 0% and 5%.
At the midpoint of guidance, Alpha’s thermal coal is fully committed for the year at an average price of $76.06 per ton.
